out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restricted Use Pesticide, Conditions of use
violations.observation: Restricted, commercial use pesticides present in the facility are applied by the operator who is not a certified pesticide applicator. Observed storage of hot shot roach spray stored below 3 compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: Because of their toxicity, restricted use pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. Person in charge discarded cans of pesticide.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at handwashing sink next to 3 compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. PIC refilled hand soap dispenser.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device during inspection.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. Please obtain a food thermometer and submit invoice to EHS within 10 days.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored in Packaging
violations.observation: Various single use containers were observed stored unprotected (food contact surface face up) at the cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Single-service items shall be stored in a clean, dry location that is not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. In addition, the single-service items shall be kept in the original protective package or stored by using other means that afford protection from contamination until used. PIC turned single use containers with food contact surface face down.

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present in the establishment.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. A follow-up will be conducted within 10 days.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage-Personal Care Items
violations.observation: Observed hand lotion stored above food preparation surface in such a way that they could contaminate food and food contact surfaces.
violations.corrective_action: All employees' personal care items shall be stored in a way that prevents the contamination of food and food contact surfaces through improper labeling or storage. PIC discarded lotion.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Frozen dumplings and other food items stored on the floor of walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PIC placed all items on storage rack.

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. CFM arrived during inspection.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw shell egg stored above chicken broth in unit (1)
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC placed raw egg below all ready to eat items.
